summary: Master data management, manipulation, and analysis with our comprehensive Excel course. Enhance your skills and boost your career potential today!
lede: Excel data analysis training is for experienced professionals who need to organize high volumes of data and produce reports. It covers importing and cleaning data with Power Query, building relational models, and using DAX calculations to analyze results. Learners also practice creating interactive dashboards and applying regression, forecasting, and scenario tools to support financial and operational reporting.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for experienced professionals who manage high volumes of data and require advanced automation and modeling capabilities to support executive-level reporting.
modules: Relational Data Modeling with Power Pivot
prerequisites: Participants should have a strong working knowledge of Excel, including proficiency with VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, basic PivotTables, and nested IF statements. No prior experience with Power Query or DAX is required, though familiarity with basic data concepts is beneficial. A laptop with Excel 2019 or Microsoft 365 (Windows version) is required to access Power Pivot features.
